workflows.name: single_sample_spatial_clustering
workflows.intent: Perform spatially-informed cell-typing or domain segmentation on a single spatial transcriptomics sample.
workflows.stages: 1. Load and preprocess data into a SpatialExperiment object ;; 2. Compute neighborhood feature matrices ;; 3. Run PCA on the BANKSY matrix ;; 4. Cluster the BANKSY embedding ;; 5. Relabel clusters to minimize differences ;; 6. Compare cluster outputs using Adjusted Rand Index (ARI)
workflows.code:
se <- SpatialExperiment(
    assay = list(processedExp = gcm),
    spatialCoords = locs,
    colData = mdata
)
se <- Banksy::computeBanksy(se, assay_name = aname, k_geom = k_geom)
se <- Banksy::runBanksyPCA(se, lambda = lambda, npcs = npcs)
se <- Banksy::clusterBanksy(se, lambda = lambda, npcs = npcs, resolution = 0.8)
se <- connectClusters(se)
compareClusters(se, func = "ARI")

workflows.name: multi_sample_joint_clustering
workflows.intent: Jointly cluster multiple spatial transcriptomics samples with optional spatial label smoothing.
input: spe_list (list of SpatialExperiment objects, one per sample)
workflows.stages: 1. Compute BANKSY neighborhood feature matrices for each sample separately ;; 2. Merge samples into a joint object ;; 3. Run joint PCA with sample grouping ;; 4. Run joint UMAP ;; 5. Cluster the joint embedding ;; 6. Connect clusters across runs ;; 7. Split the joint object back into individual samples ;; 8. Smooth cluster labels per sample ;; 9. Compare clusters using Adjusted Rand Index (ARI)
workflows.code:
spe_list <- lapply(spe_list, computeBanksy, assay_name = aname, compute_agf = compute_agf, k_geom = k_geom)
spe_joint <- do.call(cbind, spe_list)
spe_joint <- runBanksyPCA(spe_joint, use_agf = use_agf, lambda = lambda, group = "sample_id", seed = 1000)
spe_joint <- runBanksyUMAP(spe_joint, use_agf = use_agf, lambda = lambda, seed = 1000)
spe_joint <- clusterBanksy(spe_joint, use_agf = use_agf, lambda = lambda, resolution = res, seed = 1000)
spe_joint <- connectClusters(spe_joint)
spe_list <- lapply(sample_names, function(x) spe_joint[, spe_joint$sample_id == x])
spe_list <- lapply(spe_list, smoothLabels, cluster_names = cnm, k = 6L, verbose = FALSE)
compareClusters(spe_list$sample_151673, func = 'ARI')

workflows.name: spatial_integration_with_harmony
workflows.intent: Integrate multiple spatial transcriptomics datasets using Harmony on the BANKSY embedding to correct for batch effects.
input: spe (SpatialExperiment object containing multiple samples with staggered coordinates)
workflows.stages: 1. Compute BANKSY neighborhood matrices ;; 2. Run PCA on the BANKSY matrix ;; 3. Run Harmony on the BANKSY PCA embedding ;; 4. Run UMAP on the Harmony-corrected embedding ;; 5. Cluster the Harmony-corrected embedding ;; 6. Connect clusters to reference annotations
workflows.code:
spe <- computeBanksy(spe, assay_name = aname, compute_agf = compute_agf, k_geom = k_geom)
spe <- runBanksyPCA(spe, use_agf = use_agf, lambda = lambda, npcs = npcs, seed = SEED)
harmony_embedding <- harmony::RunHarmony(
    data_mat = reducedDim(spe, "PCA_M1_lam0.2"),
    meta_data = colData(spe),
    vars_use = c("sample_id", "subject_id"),
    max_iter = 20,
    verbose = FALSE
)
reducedDim(spe, "Harmony_BANKSY") <- harmony_embedding
spe <- runBanksyUMAP(spe, use_agf = TRUE, lambda = lambda, npcs = npcs)
spe <- runBanksyUMAP(spe, dimred = "Harmony_BANKSY")
spe <- clusterBanksy(spe, dimred = "Harmony_BANKSY", resolution = 0.55, seed = SEED)
spe <- connectClusters(spe, map_to = "clust_annotation")
